scope: All 50 public research-context cases. The released benchmark requests analysis proposals and uses an LLM judge; it does not validate executed biological artifacts. release_execution_caveat: The pinned agent runner names three CSV files absent from this tree; the base-model runner names the released cellbench_50.csv. Source execution was not attempted.
